messages:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: Pager — High error rate on hosted inference (eu-west-1). Notifying on-call and SRE rotation. Thread opened 1799994321.

ops_zoe: seeing surge of 500s hitting text-gen endpoints. Error pattern: container OOM -> crashloop -> node reboot. Started ~10:12 UTC, spike 10:15-10:22. Autoscaler reported 3 rapid scale-ups and 2 scale-downs in last 8 minutes.

infra_bot: quick snapshot from cluster logs:
```
[10:14:37] gpu-node-14 kubelet: container "runtime-proxy" terminated: OOMKilled
[10:15:02] runtime: ERROR CUDA: out of memory while allocating 2048MB
[10:16:10] autoscaler: scale_up event: +6 pods (target pool=gpu-inference-eu)
[10:17:50] kubelet: Node gpu-node-14 NotReady (kernel panic) -> reboot
[10:18:05] container-logs: repeated segfaults in /usr/local/bin/inference-runtime
```

sre_miguel: I can take lead. First goals: 1) mitigate customer impact, 2) stop the scale oscillation, 3) stabilize nodes. Plan: cordon noisy nodes, disable cluster autoscaler for gpu pool, pin minimal capacity, route traffic to fallback pool.

eng_oncall: on it. Disabling autoscaler now and setting scale-down delay longer. Commands I'm running:
```
kubectl patch deployment gpu-inference --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":8}}' --namespace=redwood
kubectl annotate deployment gpu-inference cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/scale-down-disabled=true
# temporarily scale down aggressive HPA targets
kubectl patch hpa gpu-inference-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'
```

infra_dev_sam: cordoning affected nodes so they don't get new pods:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-14 && kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
kubectl drain gpu-node-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

ops_zoe: support update — impacted requests ~= 18% error rate for text-gen v2 models; latency spiked to 2.5x. Top affected customers: cust-alfa (some jobs failed), cust-beta (streaming timeouts). No PII exposures.

support_jake: I'm pinging account execs for cust-alfa and cust-beta now. Sending a short RCA note: transient runtime OOM -> retry loops -> request queue backlog -> autoscaler rapid scale -> thrash -> more OOMs. ETA for mitigation 10–15m.

eng_oncall: noticing a recent runtime build rolled 3 hours ago with a changed memory allocator flag. Rolling it back for canary lanes. Rolling back on canary first.

deploy_bot: deploy request accepted: rollback runtime v7.3.1 -> v7.2.4 on canary (canary group: 5% traffic). Starting 10:23 UTC.

infra_bot: routing update: shifting non-critical traffic to cpu-fallback pool (lower-cost, higher-latency) to relieve gpu pressure. Config change applied to routing ruleset-rl: route low-priority model ids to cpu-fallback.

sre_miguel: further mitigations applied: increased kube eviction thresholds, bumped network packet buffer limits, and set heavier damping on autoscaler (scale up min interval 5m). Also temporarily disabled preemptible GPU nodes in pool.

ops_zoe: after changes: error rate down to 6%, latency trending back toward baseline. A few nodes still rebooting but most workloads are stable. We still see occasional CUDA allocation failures on older GPUs — tracking.

pm_lina: quick ask — what's customer impact summary and timeline so we can notify accounts + status page? Need bullet points for account emails.

support_jake: short summary draft:
- Incident start: 10:12 UTC — increased 500s on hosted inference in eu-west-1.
- Root symptoms: GPU OOMs and container crashloops after recent runtime allocator change.
- Impact: ~18% of text-gen requests failed at peak; major customers A/B affected; degraded latency for others.
- Mitigation: rollback runtime on canaries, cordon/drain unstable nodes, disable autoscaler to stop thrash, route low-priority traffic to cpu fallback.
- Current status: error rate ~6%, serving performance stabilizing; full remediation in progress.
- Next steps: full rollback if canary stable, re-enable autoscaler with conservative settings, postmortem.

eng_oncall: canary rollback to v7.2.4 looked good — no OOMs in canary group for 6m. Initiating wider rollback across EU pools, starting 10:34 UTC.

deploy_bot: rollback rollout started for eu-west-1 pools. Progress: 0/12 -> 4/12 -> 9/12 nodes updated.

infra_dev_sam: note — when rolling back, we should avoid simultaneous drain of many nodes. Draining one node at a time so we don't trigger scheduling spikes.

sre_miguel: agreed. Also we should create a temporary capacity reservation (pin replica counts) to avoid autoscaler re-trigger when rollback finishes. Leaving autoscaler disabled until postmortem.

ops_zoe: marking customers impacted for follow-up: cust-alfa (high), cust-beta (medium), cust-gamma (low). Support will assign severity and outreach.

pm_lina: thanks — I'll coordinate account comms and put a note on status.redwood with current mitigations.

support_jake: outreach messages queued. Will update thread when customers confirm recovery.

eng_oncall: final check — error rate now ~1.2% and latency back to 1.1x baseline. Rolling autoscaler back on hold. Will keep autoscaler disabled until SRE confirms safe thresholds.

incident_bot: Incident update logged. Severity: Sev-2. On-call: eng_oncall. SRE lead: sre_miguel. Open follow-ups: postmortem, runtime allocator rollback verification, autoscaler tuning ticket.

sre_miguel: assigning action items: (1) postmortem write-up (me) (2) runtime allocator config review (eng runtime) (3) autoscaler damping config + runbook update (infra) — target due EOD. If no objections, I'll close the immediate incident thread in 30m.

ops_zoe: no objections. Marking incident as mitigated for now. :white_check_mark:
